selectedFunctions.label: Adjust owned SAFE collateral and normalized debt
warnings: Managed SAFE actions require preexisting ownership or safeCan delegation. Native ODProxy ownership is not a backend-supported generic executor path; no execute/delegatecall, allowSAFE, SAFE-rights or token authority is granted, and a complete direct-EOA CDP workflow is not promised.
Signed collateral and debt deltas are 18-decimal wad units; debt is normalized, multiplied by current accumulated ray rate for internal rad accounting. Debt changes first collect collateral tax.

If nonSafeHandlerAddress=false, collateral/debt credits use the owned SAFE handler; true uses caller credits and requires prior engine consent. Negative debt consumes internal coins, not automatically wallet OD. Debt ceilings, collateral safety and debt-floor checks may revert.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Consolidate two already-controlled same-collateral SAFEs
warnings: Managed SAFE actions require preexisting ownership or safeCan delegation. Native ODProxy ownership is not a backend-supported generic executor path; no execute/delegatecall, allowSAFE, SAFE-rights or token authority is granted, and a complete direct-EOA CDP workflow is not promised.

Both source and destination must be caller-controlled/preauthorized, destination handler must exist and collateral types must match. Transfers the entire locked collateral and normalized debt, then updates both NFTs and removes source from owner lists; source NFT ownership is not erased.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Move owned SAFE free collateral to ledger recipient
warnings: Managed SAFE actions require preexisting ownership or safeCan delegation. Native ODProxy ownership is not a backend-supported generic executor path; no execute/delegatecall, allowSAFE, SAFE-rights or token authority is granted, and a complete direct-EOA CDP workflow is not promised.

Transfers only free internal collateral credits for the SAFE collateral type, in 18-decimal wad units, from the handler to dst. It does not unlock pledged collateral or send an ERC20; adapter exit is separate.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Move specified collateral credits from owned SAFE
warnings: Managed SAFE actions require preexisting ownership or safeCan delegation. Native ODProxy ownership is not a backend-supported generic executor path; no execute/delegatecall, allowSAFE, SAFE-rights or token authority is granted, and a complete direct-EOA CDP workflow is not promised.

Caller must control the SAFE; explicit cType selects its free internal collateral denomination. Moves wad credits from that SAFE handler to dst, not arbitrary external token execution. NFT state is updated.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Move owned SAFE internal OD balance to recipient
warnings: Managed SAFE actions require preexisting ownership or safeCan delegation. Native ODProxy ownership is not a backend-supported generic executor path; no execute/delegatecall, allowSAFE, SAFE-rights or token authority is granted, and a complete direct-EOA CDP workflow is not promised.
Moves existing internal coin credits from owned SAFE handler to dst, in rad units (45 decimals), not wallet OD. CoinJoin.exit requires independent preexisting engine authorization and separate call.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Withdraw caller wstETH collateral credits
warnings: Debits caller free internal collateral balance and sends wstETH to account; amount uses underlying token decimals. It cannot spend another account credits or unlock pledged collateral.
Adapter has existing SAFEEngine authorization, but the catalog grants none to users; only sufficient caller-owned free collateral credits can be withdrawn.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Deposit wstETH into OpenDollar collateral accounting
warnings: Transfers wstETH from caller under existing token allowance and credits account internal collateral. Amount is native token units (wstETH18); ledger uses18-decimal wad conversion.

Join requires both child and factory enabled; depositing collateral credits alone does not open an NFV, pledge collateral or borrow OD. Recipient is a fixed accounting address, not executable payload.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Redeem caller internal coins into wallet OD
warnings: Moves caller-owned internal rad coin credits to CoinJoin and mints18-decimal OD to account at wad times1e27 conversion. Requires preexisting SAFEEngine consent for CoinJoin to move caller credits; no consent grant admitted.
Exit requires CoinJoin enabled. It spends internal coins, not arbitrary debt or another SAFE collateral, and does not establish backing or stablecoin solvency.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

selectedFunctions.label: Burn caller OD for internal coin accounting
warnings: Pulls caller OD under preexisting ERC20 allowance and burns it, moving CoinJoin internal coins to account. Amount is18-decimal OD wad; corresponding engine credit is wad times1e27 rad.
This creates internal coin balance for potential repayment, not automatic repayment of an owned SAFE. Fixed OD/SAFEEngine bindings; no arbitrary token or callback.
Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.

export const getTokenList = (network: GebDeployment): TokenList => {
    return tokens[network]
}

export const getAddressList = (network: GebDeployment): ContractList => {
    return addresses[network]
}

export const getTokenDetails = (network: GebDeployment, tokenSymbol: string): TokenData | null => {
    const tokenList = getTokenList(network)
    if (tokenSymbol in tokenList) {
        return tokenList[tokenSymbol]
    }
    return null
}

export const getSubgraph = (network: GebDeployment): string => {
    return subgraphs[network]
}

     * - `to` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`.
     * - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     */
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external;

    /**
     * @dev Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account.
     * The approval is cleared when the token is transferred.
     *
     * Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator.
     * - `tokenId` must exist.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     */
    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external;

    /**
     * @dev Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller.
     * Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - The `operator` cannot be the caller.
     *
     * Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.
     */
    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external;

    /**
     * @dev Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `tokenId` must exist.
     */
    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address operator);

    /**
     * @dev Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`.
     *
     * See {setApprovalForAll}
     */
    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool);
}

Current v1.7.0 generated contracts documentation points deployment addresses to app.opendollar.com/stats and primary GitHub repository.

configurationObservations.nativeProxyConstraint: Vault721.mint requires _proxyRegistry[_proxy]!=address(0); its NFT recipient is the mapped user, while SAFE manager owner is native proxy. sourceSemantics.collateralAdapter: Caller-funded ERC20 deposit creates collateral ledger credit; exit burns caller free credit and transfers fixed wstETH. This is real financial collateral accounting, not a bare transfer helper.

sourceSemantics.managedSAFE: Fixed owned/preauthorized position adjustment and ledger disbursement/consolidation; no arbitrary target/payload/callback. Tax collector, NFT registry, SAFEEngine solvency parameters and oracle prices remain material dependencies.

limitations: Static source/ABI catalog metadata only; no grant, complete workflow, live runtime/eligibility, liquidity, backing, yield or financial-safety assurance.
